title: Choose the composer's visual direction
question: The roll assigned Order Rail. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Order Rail
options.lineage: kitchen order tickets on the pass rail
options.thesis: Every message is a ticket you HOLD for the end of the turn or FIRE into it.
options.viewport: Composer as one ticket: a printed head (agent, branch, model, effort, authority, context used) over the body; queued tickets clip to a rail above it; a HOLD | FIRE control replaces the lone arrow while a turn runs.
options.risk: The HOLD/FIRE words read as a kitchen costume if the ticket head gets perforations or receipt type.

raised.raise: Hierarchy by type size and weight only: the three settings lose their chip borders and sit in the ticket head as text.
One reserved ink: the primary accent marks only the single send action (FIRE or Send), nothing else in the composer.
Context used, send mode and branch pack into one ruled head line with no padding inflation.
A queued ticket that is sent or removed stays in place for a moment stamped SENT or REMOVED, with Undo, instead of vanishing.
Fixed furniture: every control keeps its position across idle, running and parked; Stop no longer shifts Send.

options.label: Telegram Blank
options.thesis: A message blank: routing boxes above a ruled body, and a service class that decides delivery.
options.viewport: Labelled cells TO · MODEL · EFFORT · AUTHORITY above the body; the footer holds the service class Queue (after this turn) / Steer (now) and the context count.
options.risk: Closest to a plain structured form; familiar, and can read bureaucratic if the labels get loud.

options.label: Night Line
options.thesis: The session is a line; the composer is the next station, and queued messages are stations ahead.
options.viewport: A thin cobalt line runs down the composer's left edge from the transcript into queued stops and the draft; context used is the distance left to the terminus.
options.case: Holds audience: the midnight ground suits the dark desktop scene and reaches the sidebar; loses on clarity, a line diagram explains less than HOLD/FIRE.
options.risk: Line inks crowd the One Voice Rule's status colours, and the blue ground changes the whole app, not only the composer.

options.label: Ticket Wallet
options.thesis: Queued messages as coupons that tear off in order.
options.viewport: Coupon book of queued messages over the draft.
options.risk: Carrier red collides with the failed-status red.
options.case: Fuses on the queue only; William does not identify with airline paper, and red breaks the One Voice Rule.
options.kept: States are stamped in place, nothing silently disappears.

options.label: Type Specimen
options.viewport: A slider for thinking effort over the draft.
options.risk: Effort has five discrete levels, not a continuous axis.
options.case: Loses both axes: the slider misstates a discrete setting.
options.kept: Hierarchy by type scale alone, no boxes.

options.label: Orienteering Map
options.thesis: A purple course over fixed terrain colours.
options.risk: Yellow and green terrain inks collide with status colours.
options.case: Loses both axes; nothing in the composer is terrain.
options.kept: One ink reserved for exactly one job.

options.label: High-density Grid
options.thesis: Every module ruled and packed edge to edge.
options.risk: Utility red collides with failed status.
options.case: Loses both axes for a single input.
options.kept: Density courage in the status line.

options.label: Character Goods
options.thesis: A ranked roster, each with fixed furniture.
options.risk: Pastel mascots contradict the native-app brand.
options.kept: Controls keep fixed positions in every state.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The Claude Desktop / Cursor composer, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Rounded field, settings as quiet inline selects, attach and send at the corners, a context ring by Send.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other agent chat app by design.
